items.text: [p align="start"]Version 1.0.187.3871

Fixed a bug that allowed players to leave the base in a boat with a higher rank than permitted by the Ship Captain skill. (Important: This fix takes effect immediately only for new players. For existing players, it will take effect only after starting a New Game.)
Fixed a bug where modules linked to other modules could become unavailable after interrupting boat assembly.
The introductory cutscene after completing the tutorial is no longer skipped due to the rewards notification. It now also plays when the tutorial is skipped.
Fixed the sorting of numbered locations in the Translocator.
Fixed a message that appeared in all caps while connecting.
[p align="start"]Version 1.0.184.3867
Fixed FPS drops and freezes when idle crew members perform repairs.
Fixed FPS drops caused by large numbers of lost cargo markers at sea.
Optimized compass performance.
Fixed a false module replacement warning during boat assembly, even when the modules were identical.
Fixed potential item duplication in cargo lost after boarding.
Cargo lost after boarding can once again be recovered from resource traders.
Fixed an issue that could prevent modules from being used after a failed attempt to assemble a boat from a blueprint.
Fixed potential issues with inventory item stacks exceeding their limits.
Fixed stuck quest states in "Murderous Balloon" and "A New Thing From Laoshai".
Fixed potential loss of recent progress when an error occurs during a transition between instances.
The "Broken Intercom" quest now provides a hint that you must first fulfill your promise to the Mermaid.
Clarified the quest objective: "Sink or capture the Atman flagship".
Renamed the mouse inversion setting to "Invert Mouse Look Y-Axis".
Fixed an issue with Commando trophy shields dropping during boarding.
Fixed issues with certain sounds, including crew voice lines, the capture timer, and the death siren.
Fixed the "Report Bug" button in certain error dialogs.
Fixed the aiming direction of other players on foot.
Fixed a tooltip in the clan menu.
Fixed news formatting in the main menu.
Fixed connection issues for players from the RF (PC).
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/7524f17b7cf244df4c86e2db6468f37de0e9650b.jpg"]
Added the foundation of the clan system: players can now create clans, join them, and form persistent communities.
Walking locations are now shared between players. You can choose which crew member to control. The walking-mode camera, including combat behavior, and ladder traversal have been improved.
Added quest party finder and the ability to use the Translocator to join activities of other party members.
Reworked shared quest progress and rewards for assisting in combat so player participation is accounted for more fairly.
Added automatic boat guidance along streams while using Full Ahead.
Crew settings are now saved separately for each boat and each saved blueprint.
Fixed numerous issues in quests and dialogues, including problems that could prevent further progress.

We have added the foundation of the clan system — the first stage of its further development. Players can already create clans, join them, and form persistent communities. Clan activities, ways to earn clan currency, and clan-related rewards will appear in later stages of the system’s development.
Clans can be created, found through search, and used to invite other players.
A clan can have up to 20 members. Once clan activities are introduced, we will add the ability to expand clan capacity.
Clan members now have a separate Clan text chat channel.
A clan member can be invited to a regular party directly from the clan member list.

The Owner, Officer, and Member roles are available. The Owner and Officers can manage clan membership, while the Owner can also transfer ownership to another member, change faction, rename the clan, or disband it.
When created, a clan receives 500 units of clan currency as a one-time grant. Spend it carefully: clan currency cannot currently be earned in this version of the game.
Clan names must follow the established naming rules. Inappropriate names can be reported. We will moderate clan names and ask players to follow the rules when creating them.
Disbanding a clan is irreversible: members are removed, invitations are cancelled, and the clan name cannot be reused.
Clan names are displayed above players. This can be disabled with the Show clan names above players setting.
Clan leaderboards will be introduced together with clan activities.
Walking locations are now shared: you can see other players and their actions there. This is the foundation for further development of cooperative play in walking mode.

At Volcano entrance, you can already try the first test version of cooperative walking combat: party members can enter together and try to clear the enemies that appear. This is still a basic implementation of the new system with no separate reward. We plan to further develop walking mode with new quests, equipment, weapons, and cooperative gameplay options.
The number of players currently inside a city is displayed above city parking areas.
When entering walking mode, you can now choose which crew member to control.
A normal interaction uses the previously selected character, while holding the interaction button opens character selection.
The selected character is remembered and used by default on subsequent entries into walking mode.

Reworked the camera and aiming in non-combat and combat walking mode. In combat, the weapon now follows the camera reticle, allowing you to properly aim at targets, including those above or below the character.
Ladders are now used as full traversal routes with climbing and descending animations instead of teleportation.

The previously closed Volcano entrance location is now available to visit on foot. When combat starts, enemies appear for party members to try clearing together. After the fight is completed, the area becomes peaceful again, and the battle becomes available again after 5 minutes.
Added the /dance text chat command: on a boat it makes the entire crew dance, while in walking mode it affects the controlled character.
Party invitations can now also be sent to players who have not yet been added as friends.
Improved the player search interface: results are no longer selected automatically, and actions for a found player become available after selecting them.
Incoming and outgoing invitations are displayed separately and show their current state.
Pending invitations are shown at the top of the list.
Fixed cleanup of stale invitations after declining, blocking, reconnecting, or joining another party.
Improved notifications for friend and party invitations.
A Find party button has been added to the quest journal.
Search can be started alone or together with an already formed party.
Players and parties looking for members for the same quest are automatically combined into one party.
The button shows the search state and the number of found members.
Search can be cancelled at any time.
You can search for a party for no more than five quests at the same time.
A normal search lasts up to 20 minutes. Once a match is found, up to another 5 minutes are provided to complete party formation.
The Translocator can now show the activity of another party member.
It can be used to join a quest or instance where another party member is already present.
Party destinations now have separate visual presentation.
A Party Activity Available notification has been added.
These notifications can be disabled in the settings.
Dialogue answers made available through the party are now marked “(from party)”.
We reworked reward distribution in cooperative battles so that the contributions of multiple players are accounted for more fairly and quest rewards no longer depend on who lands the final hit.
Regular Loot and Experience
Rewards for destroying enemies in PvE are now determined by contribution to the fight rather than only by the finishing blow.
For regular enemies, the player who deals the most damage receives the full reward, while up to the next three contributors receive 75% experience and a reduced chance to receive regular loot.

Some major bosses use expanded shared-reward rules. These apply to Boss I–Boss V, fights with Jared, Dreadreaper, and the Atman flagship in Raid: several players can receive the full participation reward from these fights.
If a fight belongs to a specific player's activity, the activity owner always receives the full reward; other participants can also receive rewards for their contribution.
Quest Rewards and Party Progress
Quest items are now distributed separately from regular loot and are personal to each player.
Party members who are in the same game area and meet the quest requirements can receive their own quest items regardless of how regular rewards are distributed.
Improved kill and assist credit for quest objectives during cooperative play.
Fixed an issue where a successful boarding action could sometimes fail to count as destroying an enemy for quest objectives.
Loot Pickup
Multiple regular loot drops from one destroyed enemy can now be combined into a single object, reducing the number of separate objects after large battles.
Quest loot and other drops requiring separate handling are not combined with regular loot.
If there is not enough room in the cargo hold, currency from the loot is still picked up immediately, while the remaining items can be collected manually.
Crew settings are now saved separately for each boat and each saved blueprint.
Returning to a boat restores the previous crew roles, workstations, and assigned items.
Improved restoration of crew settings after changing boats, boarding, moving between locations, and reconnecting.
Improved automatic assignment of crew members to suitable positions.
Fixed restoration of the helmsman after changing the boat configuration.
Added separate warnings for cases where the boat has no helm or no crew member is assigned to it.
Fixed updating crew stats and modifiers in the shipyard.
Descriptions now show full stat and modifier names instead of unclear icons.
Improved the constructor when working with very dense boat builds. If some parts cannot be attached correctly, they are returned to the inventory with a notification.
Usable items, character equipment, and quest items now have distinct frames so they are easier to tell apart.
Fixed gamepad navigation in the inventory and flickering item details.
Fixed the Back button on gamepads in the Settings menu when a dropdown list is selected.
Item transfer windows now also show quest items and other items that cannot be transferred manually. Such items are displayed as locked.
Fixed item sorting.
Some resources related to Atman quests can now be sold to traders and placed in storage:
Atman Fuel Sample;
Atman Armor Fragment;
Atman Weapon Fragment;
Atman Insignia;
Reaper Fuel Sample.
Improved restoration of research quests after a skipped processing stage.
The research menu now shows a more precise hint: “Complete the technology quest to unlock this research.”
Quests with waiting periods now display the remaining time, and their timers continue counting down while the player is offline.
Fixed dialogues that could open several transitions at once, leave a hidden reference to an unavailable character, or block further progress.
Fixed cases where controls remained locked, cinematic bars stayed on screen, or an incorrect character marker remained after dialogue.
Added automatic cleanup of temporary quest items after successfully completing the corresponding quests.
Treasure Rush now becomes available only after the required progression: completing Heroes Triumph and obtaining a boat of at least Rank 4.

Hydrogen for Kim, A Note for Kim, and Optics for Kim — fixed the quest sequence and an issue that could stop Kim’s questline while obtaining the optics. Related quest items and outdated quest states are also corrected for older saves.
Murderous Trap — fixed the conditions for progressing to the quest.
The Arrival / Three Whales — fixed a blocker in the early quest chain that could occur after death and respawning.
Ghosts from the Balloon — fixed the respawn point.
Finding Fighters — fixed the stage text and required pier.
New Contact — fixed a dialogue blocker when transitioning from the Twins to Diogenes.
Key to the Safe / General Gathering — fixed transition and marker issues.
Guaranteed Delivery — fixed restoration of the caravan state and restart timing.
Secret Blueprints, Second Attempt, and several base-development quests — fixed quest items that could remain after completion.
Fighters for the Colosseum — fixed an issue that could make Antonius unavailable.
Raid — fixed assist credit when destroying the target boss.
Golden AK — fixed an issue where quest loot might not appear if the boss was defeated first.
Familiar Jaws — evidence is now personal to each player.
The Caravan with the Figurine / Delivery Canceled — fixed quest loot appearance conditions.
Rare Trophies — fixed an issue that could cause the Atman Insignia to drop before the quest started.
Hunting — fixed the mining point during the quest-loot stage.
The Guard — fixed the caravan position.
Reduced the number of jet ski riders around Three Whales.

Added automatic boat guidance along streams while using the Full Ahead speed-control mode (Ctrl+W by default). If the mode is enabled inside a stream, the boat starts following it; if the mode is already enabled, guidance activates when entering a stream flowing in the direction of travel. Manual steering disables automatic guidance.
Improved saving the boat's position when parking at cities and other locations. Fixed cases where the boat could appear in the wrong place or inside city geometry after returning or logging back in.
Improved transitions between the regular world and instances, as well as restoration of group quest instance state.
Fixed issues restoring the ship and character after ship destruction, emergency repair, transitions, and reconnecting.
Added the Additional lighting video setting, improving visibility of characters and objects in shadows and at night. It can be disabled on lower-performance systems.
Fixed a delay and hitching when entering walking mode after parking.
Fixed an issue that could cause the game to hang or shut down incorrectly when exiting.
Fixed text and voice chat reconnection after logging out and signing back in.
Improved game behavior during maintenance: instead of immediately closing, the client returns to the start screen, and if the game version changes during maintenance, the client shuts down correctly.
The player's nickname is now displayed consistently throughout the game.
Fixed the display of the Maintenance status on the client.
Fixed an issue where modules could appear in incorrect positions when assembling a boat from a saved blueprint.
The blueprint for a new boat is now granted to the player immediately when boarding begins and is accompanied by a pop-up notification.
Added specific messages for the result of assembling a boat from a saved blueprint (insufficient resources, etc.).
Added a confirmation prompt when deleting saved blueprints.
Added module limit display for the boat in the building menu.
Fixed the display of names in weapon groups.
Fixed issues accessing the Twins in certain quests and dialogues.
Fixed an issue where the free slot status in the Base docks would not update, which could temporarily block some quests.
Fixed an issue that could cause empty dialogues and long dialogue loading times.
Fixed a boat position desync issue that could cause the boat to get stuck in Three Whales.
Fixed an issue with reconnecting to the correct text chat channels.
Fixed an issue with log and network message overflow that could cause the game to crash for some players.
Fixed several issues related to FMOD spatial audio.
Fixed an issue that could cause long hangs in the Boarding menu or while entering the game.
Fixed an inventory issue that could lead to item loss.
Fixed the display of controls in docks with multiple berths and when using a gamepad.
Fixed the translocation position at the North Workshop.
Added clarifications to some Base quests related to other quests.
Added missing localization strings for sea merchants.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/21b7647e31cb34798d992fd7ec1cef763294fcf9.jpg"]

Fixed an issue where assembling a boat from a saved blueprint loaded incorrect modules. Now saved blueprints install the exact modules that were stored. If those modules are missing from the base storage, same-model analogs will be used, as before. If modules are missing or resources are insufficient, a message will display a list of the required missing items.
Fixed certain dialogs and quests in the Order of the Kraken questline that could soft-lock progress.
Fixed issues causing delayed appearance or disappearance of quest markers.
Updated base boat-selection menus — now fit the required number of boats.
Corrected inaccuracies in some localizations.
Added the ability to send an "error report" even without a connection to the game server.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/ad30e23e47874e79eb21836aefeb020c3f70bb19.jpg"]
• Improved network connection stability.
• Added language-based text chat channels.
• Added extra filter and sorting options in the base production window.
• Added rank filter to the boat blueprint window at the base.
• Fixed automatic addition of hull blueprints to the base when using a new boat.
• Fixed armor slots on the Octa hull.
• Fixed the mast category in structures.
• Fixed various localization errors.
• Slight optimization of the first enemies when approaching Three Whales.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/2dcac27ff136595c7d0c7a66439d633582677a90.jpg"]
Added display of hotkey on the "Take All" button.
Added display of hotkey on the Translocator icon.
Fixed display of the rotation angle characteristic icon for outboard motors.
Added display of the game camera’s view direction on the fullscreen map.
In voice chat, default setting changed to "Hear only group members".
After boarding a new boat, its hull is now automatically added to the list of blueprints at the base.
Fixed marker in the Atmans bomb quest.
Fixed quest names in the starting questline for obtaining a boat from the Shipbuilder.
Added a quest to the starting questline to simplify initial access to the base. Access to the base is now possible before hiring a manager.
Fixed a bug where the Steering Cabins bonus to battery durability also incorrectly affected hull side durability.
Alter Ego skill "Equipment Master" now adds 3, 6, 9, 12, and 15 units of generated energy per hull rank instead of 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 earlier.
Kichiro and Paul’s skill "Equipment Master" now adds 3 units of generated energy per hull rank instead of 1 earlier.
Increased speed gain from Rank 1 outboard motor from 5 to 7.
Increased speed gain from Rank 2 outboard motor from 10 to 14.
Increased base energy generation of all hulls. Rank 1 hulls now average up to 30, Rank 5 hulls up to 90 ("ST Okta" with its 600 remains unchanged).
Decorative Horse module now occupies less space and has a smaller installation slot.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/1d884a1cfdb1c8c263a1fcdfb0970d2469130f37.jpg"]
Errors related to the addition of the new "Armor" category have been fixed. Bonuses to rocket characteristics have been added for the Old Tank Base. Minor balance adjustments have been made.
A bug that prevented viewing items from the "Armor" category in the base production menu and, consequently, their production has been fixed.
A bug that caused the display of characteristics for items from the "Armor" category to be turned off has been fixed.
An icon for items from the "Armor" category has been added to the item card and repair menu.
The category for some turret bases has been corrected; they are now correctly filtered by the "Structures" category and repaired according to the set repair priority for this category.
Old Tank Base
Level has been increased from 3 to 5.
Energy consumption has been increased from 1 to 24.
Mass has been increased from 1700 to 2400.
Durability has been increased from 2400 to 18000.
Bonuses to weapons installed on the base have been reworked.
The base enhances cannons: +40% damage, vertical aiming angles +250%, turn speed +70%.
The base enhances rocket launchers: +30% damage, rocket flight speed +30%, rocket maneuverability +25%.
Helicopter Scrap Base
Level has been increased from 3 to 5.
Durability has been increased from 3000 to 9000.
Bonus to explosive damage for grenade launchers has been reduced from 150% to 100%
Bonus to explosion radius for grenade launchers has been reduced from 5 to 4 meters.
“Jared's Smoke Grenade Launcher”
Base explosive damage has been increased from 3960 to 4800.
Explosion radius has been increased from 13 to 14 meters.

Comment: The enhancement of the launcher is aimed at compensating for the weakening of bonuses to grenade launchers from the Abrams turret base, as the smoke launcher cannot be considered a standalone weapon type capable of inflicting significant damage without this base.
Cannon VI PP 100 mm by 15%.
Cannon V PP 90 mm by 25%.
Cannon IV PP 75 mm by 30%.
Cannon III PP 60 mm by 35%.
Cannon II PP 50 mm by 40%.
Cannon I PP 45 mm by 45%.

Comment: Statistics show low effectiveness of this weapon type, especially at low levels when crew reload perks are not yet leveled up. We hope that this enhancement, combined with the ability to get a 40% damage boost from the Old Tank Base, will help achieve the required effectiveness.
Bonus to explosive damage from structures has been reduced from 20% to 10%.

Comment: Statistics show an extremely high effectiveness of grenade launchers specifically in combination with installed turret bases, so we decided not to directly reduce the characteristics of grenade launchers, but only to weaken the damage bonus from structures.
Maximum range has been increased from 100 to 110.
Flame mixture flight speed has been increased from 150 to 160.
Base durability has been increased from 180,000 to 270,000.
Base turn speed has been increased from 10 to 15 deg/sec.
The characteristics of weapons now display the "Projectile velocity" parameter, and rocket characteristics display "Missile maneuverability".
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/b55c1a39328f3078b2dfe2987a2a9848d16f9c46.png"]
Atman confrontation quest fixes and minor balance adjustments.

notes.title: Fixes in the Atman confrontation quest chain

items.text: Fixed a bug that caused the client to crash when moving certain quest items from the Atmans confrontation chain to the base warehouse.
A bug where quest items for the Atman confrontation quest chain dropped even without the corresponding quests has been fixed.
Quest items from the Atman confrontation quest chain can now be thrown overboard, which will allow getting rid of items that were obtained due to an error.
A bug where it was impossible to get the "Spare Parts" quest from NPC Ashley on the aircraft carrier to obtain Atman Weapon Fragments has been fixed. This repeatable quest is now correctly issued.
A quest objective marker has been added in the aircraft carrier quest to destroy the Atman flagship.
The reward for repeatable Atman quests has been increased from 5000 to 15000 medallions.
The chance of medallions dropping from Atman ships no longer depends on the presence of active quests for obtaining their items for repeatable quests.
Text and localization fixes.

notes.title: Increased power gain from funnels, air intakes, and fan motors

items.text: Power gain from "Huge Funnel" Level 5 has been increased from 300,000 to 420,000.
Power gain from "Midsize Funnel" Level 4 has been increased from 120,000 to 170,000.
Power gain from "Warship Air Intake" Level 5 has been increased from 72,000 to 104,000.
Power gain from "Steamship Air Intake" Level 4 has been increased from 26,000 to 36,000.
Base power of Fan Motors of Rank 3-5 has been increased by 33%.
Machine Gun Rank 6: Energy consumption per shot has been increased from 10 to 16.
Grenade Launcher Rank 6: Energy consumption per shot has been increased from 30 to 60.
Bonus to explosion radius from structures has been reduced from 2 to 1 meter (except for Three-Story Cabin and Abrams turret base).
Maximum range has been increased from 100 to 120 meters.
Bullet damage falloff with distance has been reduced by 20% (effective range increased).
Maximum range has been increased from 80 to 100 meters.
Flame mixture flight speed has been increased from 120 to 150.

Comment: Minor adjustments to grenade launchers and machine guns were planned to be implemented in the update 1.0.52.3655, but were postponed to collect more statistics and analyze them. These two weapon types show higher than expected effectiveness, but due to their high popularity among players, we decided not to directly reduce their damage, but to limit it over a long firing interval by increasing energy consumption per shot. At the same time, shotguns and flamethrowers, despite their high damage, are unable to realize it due to the need for close combat with the enemy. We hope that increasing the effective attack range will allow these weapon types to find more fans.
"Jared's Smoke Grenade Launcher"
Energy consumption reduced from 210 to 140.

Comment: Although this installation is not a full-fledged weapon type, we hope that such a reduction in energy consumption will allow it to be combined with shotguns and flamethrowers for safe approach to enemies in PvP events.
Dreadripper
Shield durability covering vulnerable spots has been increased from 1,000,000 to 2,000,000.
Minigun durability has been increased from 1,000,000 to 2,000,000.
Minigun damage has been increased by 50%.
To sink Dreadripper, it is now necessary to blow up 5 fuel tanks instead of 4.
Erroneous display of the boss marker in separate locations intended for battles with other bosses has been disabled.
Display of the boss marker for players on ships below Rank 4 has been disabled.
Speed bonus has been increased from 20% to 25%.
Ship mass reduction bonus has been improved from -30% to -40%.
Resistance to burning damage disabled.
Hull mass penalty has been reduced from 15% to 10%.
Segment durability bonus has been increased from 150% to 180%.
Side armor and other protective structures have been moved to a separate inventory category, and their repair priority can now be configured separately.
The intensity of passive water ingress through a breached segment has been increased for Rank 4 and 5 hulls, by 1.5 and 2 times respectively.

Comment: This change specifically affects passive (slow) flooding of the hull when side segments are destroyed. The goal is to reduce situations where high rank ships, equipped with a large number of pumps, could remain nearly invincible even when more than half of their segments were destroyed.
Text chat pop-up messages are now separated from notifications about receiving and sorting items and other notifications. An option to disable chat messages has been added to the settings.
High-level dredges now consume significantly more energy to start the mining process.
For most rank 1 and 2 ships, base energy production has been increased by 10 units.
Visual effects of hits and module damage have been improved, and missing ones have been added.
Acidic algae, which caused damage over time to the main ship in the PvP event "Attack on Caravan", have been removed from its path.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/5afa5b6b2bdd3d8f60c8186c42467762b5c9d521.jpg"]A new quest line, new weapons - 3 flamethrowers of different rarity, reduced fleet respawn time and text chat bug fixes await you in our new update.

Added a new quest line where you have to fight the Atman fleets and disrupt their plans. Start it by talking to the mayor in Three Whales! Note: Dialogue texts in new quests may contain errors and inaccuracies, and voice acting is absent, we plan to fix this in the future.
Added three flamethrowers of different rarity
From the loot of Atman's Rank 5 ships ("Grasp", "ST Octa", "Glare" and "Midori"), which appear in some fleets on the last wave:
"Flamethrower of Atman's Initiated" can be obtained with a 1% chance.
"Flamethrower of Atman's Preachers" can be obtained with a 0.5% chance.
"Flamethrower of Atman's Inquisitors" can be obtained with a 0.1% chance.
"Flamethrower of Atman's Initiated" can be obtained with a 1.5% chance.
"Flamethrower of Atman's Preachers" can be obtained with a 1% chance.
"Flamethrower of Atman's Inquisitors" can be obtained with a 0.3% chance.
Pirate Flotillas
Respawn time interval has been reduced from 60-360 seconds to 60-75 seconds.
Atman Flotillas
Respawn time interval has been reduced from 150-450 seconds to 75-90 seconds.
Experience gained for sinking ships from the 2nd and 3rd waves has been increased from 750 to 1500.
The amount of medallions obtained from opponents of the 2nd and 3rd waves has been increased by 2 times.
Text chat bug fixes
Fixed several general text chat channel errors that caused message delivery and reception failures after grouping up.
Fixed an error that caused text chat to disconnect when voice chat was disconnected.
Text message delivery is no longer limited by distance between players.
Fixed a bug that caused the nickname of the sender of a private message to be displayed as "Unknown".
Dreadripper
Minimum spawn distance to the nearest player has been increased from 500 to 1500 meters.
Boss marker display distance has been increased from 3000 to 8000 meters.
Boss respawn time has been reduced from 40 to 30 minutes.
Fixed power consumption issue that caused four artillery guns located inside the hull to shut down.
Shield durability covering vulnerable spots has been increased from 650,000 to 1,000,000.
Miniguns have been moved from the bow platform to the side cranes.
A second four-barreled gun has been added to the bow platform.
Dead zones have been added to each weapon, for example, the rocket launcher will no longer attack at distances less than 250 meters, and all weapons have limited aiming angles.

Comment: Dreadripper has become stronger in situations where you are far from it, and it is able to fire from all weapons, but at the same time, situations where it can fire through its own hull are almost completely excluded. Thus, by getting closer to it, you can find safe places, which will become more numerous as Dreadripper's weapons are destroyed.
Boss behind the "Hunt for the 'Scuttlefish' (Group)" teleport
All weapon damage has been reduced by 25%.
Detonation of each of the three generators now reduces the boss's total durability by 9% instead of 5%.
Experience gained for destruction has been reduced from 9000 to 7000.
Time interval blocking loot drop in case of too fast repeated boss destruction has been reduced from 60 to 40 seconds.
PvP mission "Attack on Caravan"
Durability of the main ship and escort ships has been increased by 8 and 20 times respectively.
Reward for sinking caravan ships has been increased from 40,000 to 50,000 medallions.
Reward for assisting in sinking caravan ships has been increased from 40,000 to 50,000 medallions.
Reward gained per 1 second of caravan escort for defenders has been increased from 50 to 100 medallions.
Reward limit for one player has been increased from 150,000 to 200,000 medallions.
PvP mission "Treasure Hunt"
The condition for starting missions in the northeast and southeast has been simplified. Now they should start more often.
Capture point time in all locations has been increased to 180 seconds.
Reward limit for one player has been increased from 150,000 to 200,000 medallions.
Machine Guns
Overheating mechanic has been disabled.
For machine guns of levels 1-4, magazine size has been reduced to 125.

Machine gun spread now decreases with weapon level, improving accuracy. Machine guns of levels 1–4 had their spread increase per shot raised by 20–40%, while levels 5 and 6 had it lowered by 15% and 50% respectively.
Shotguns
Shotgun damage has been increased by 40%.
"Dreadripper Minigun"
Base mass has been reduced from 150,000 to 120,000.
Maximum and minimum spread has been reduced by 20%.
Maximum projectile flight distance has been increased from 600 to 700 meters.
"Jared's Smoke Grenade Launcher"
Energy consumption per shot has been reduced from 5000 to 3000.
Explosion radius has been increased from 11 to 13 meters.
Turning radius of the ST Octa Seiner has been improved.

Comment: Please note that due to the relatively low mass of the ship itself, its small width, and high speed, with a large number of heavy modules on deck, the ship may experience stability problems during sharp turns. It was impossible to improve the turning radius without these problems due to the peculiarities of the game physics engine, which strives to realistically model the behavior of ships of different hull shapes and displacements.
Durability of outboard motors of levels 2-5 has been increased by 2-2.5 times.
Cost of Smith's Neutralizer consumable, which allows resetting skills, has been reduced from 250,000 to 150,000 medallions.

To improve comfort at the start of the game, the structure of the initial quest chain has been improved, some starting locations have been moved closer to the Three Whales, and water flows have been added.
Fibers and ropes have been removed from drag repair recipes, and instrument parts from the "Looter Drone" recipe.
Base quest names are now highlighted in a different color.
Chance to get loot for assist has been increased from 25% to 33%.
In the Chasm location, gates now open from both sides.
Stack size of temporary boosters has been increased from 500 to 10,000 (already existing boosters will be combined after leaving the base).
Amount of mining loot in large zones has been reduced from 14 to 7, their respawn time has also been reduced by 2 times.
Radioisotope generator disassembly recipe has been corrected.
Improvements have been made to the anchor and compass interface, also hints about keys that call certain menus have been added.
Bonus from structures to shotgun firing range now correctly updates when moving the shotgun.

Buoys marking the boundary of the game world are now arranged in a circle, and exiting this boundary leads to teleportation to the Three Whales (in some cases this can be used instead of a translocator)
The location of the "Trader 12" island has been slightly changed so that after teleportation you can freely sail north.
Thank you for your feedback and reports. We’ve released a small update 1.0.55.3660 where we’ve fixed a few errors:

[p align="justify"]The rewards from the 'Abrams turret base' have been fixed. Players who had completed the relevant quests have now received their rewards. The old rewards have been rendered unusable and can now be salvaged for resources.
[p align="justify"]Flamethrower rewards in quests have been fixed (we’re still working on a solution for the players who have completed the corresponding quests but didn't receive flamethrowers).

In this update, the hulls of the Glare Rocket Boat and the Torpedo Boat Midori have been slightly nerfed, while the Grasp Tugboat and the ST Octa Seiner have been buffed to increase the demand for them and open up new tactical possibilities.

Machine guns—as one of the most popular and versatile weapon types—have been tweaked to make them more balanced, especially in PvP. The minigun can still fire all 480 rounds without overheating, but if you increase its magazine size with structural bonuses it may now overheat. You can avoid overheating by assigning the minigun to a crew member with the “Knowledge of Physics” skill.
We’ve also paid attention to grenade launchers: thanks to the increased projectile velocity, firing them is now more convenient, which we hope will attract new fans to this weapon class.

releases.displayName: Wind Energy and New Horizons: Q&A about the Storm Tuning Update

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/80556e764ce5ff059b49047d8ee9e73f9587323a.jpg"]

Dear friends! We’ve released an update for Age of Water: new ships and weapons have been added, the new energy system is ready to challenge your construction skills, and PvP rewards have been significantly increased.
In this post, we’ll answer the most frequent questions about the balance changes, energy, and weapons. Thank you for your support and feedback: it helps us make the game better!

notes.title: Q: What are the main goals and objectives of this update?

items.text: A: Our primary aim is to breathe new life into Age of Water and make balancing between speed, firepower, and survivability more challenging and fun. We’ve increased the variety of ships and weapons, rebalanced energy consumption and rewards, and ensured that every choice in the shipbuilder carries weight and encourages fresh tactics.

notes.title: Q: How do I rebuild my top-tier ship in light of the new changes?

items.text: A: Now there isn’t enough energy to power everything you want, so plan carefully! We recommend first removing any extra Fan Motor modules and adding structures that boost energy production. For example, the "Torpedo Boat Midori Cabin" and the "Rook Boat Cabin A" now provide huge energy bonuses, but, as with many other cabins, they’ve been moved into a new "wheelhouse" category, of which you may set up only one per ship. However, there are other cabins and modules that grant energy boosts without that restriction (see the in-game descriptions), such as the "Three-Story Cabin”," "Rook Boat Cabin B," "Rook Boat Cabin C," and the "Halibut Conning Tower." Think through module placement and their energy demands, and balance your ship’s armament, speed, hull durability, and free cargo space to fit the new meta.

notes.title: Q: How can I achieve sufficient energy after the update if I lack resources to craft generators and modules that give them bonuses?

items.text: A: The quickest and most cost-effective route is to craft wind generators at your base. They’ll cover basic needs and simple builds.

notes.title: Q: Does it still make sense to craft an expensive Rank 5 radioisotope generator if a cheaper Rank-5 wind generator produces more energy?

items.text: A: Wind generators can look more efficient at first glance, but note that they only receive durability bonuses from modules—not energy production bonuses—and each installed wind generator increases the overall energy output penalty for all wind generators.

notes.title: Q: Why did you make such radical changes to familiar gameplay elements?

items.text: A: We overhauled the core balance for the long-term health of the game, aiming to add depth and variety to ship and weapon choices. Before the patch, the dominant build was obvious—Midori, cisterns, cannons—leaving little room for alternatives. Now there are many viable builds, making it much harder to declare any single setup "the best."

notes.title: Q: Won’t these updates devalue old content and the time players invested? And why were cannons changed so drastically?

items.text: A: We don’t believe old items are devalued. On top-tier builds, standard generators remain the best choice. While weapon balance has shifted—many older weapons have actually become more effective—cannons and rockets, if anything, lost efficiency through higher energy costs rather than reduced damage. Cannons were too universally strong—about 75% of players used only them—so we increased their energy consumption to open the field to other weapon types. Their raw damage remains the same, but in the new energy scarcity meta they no longer feel as dominant. Energy efficiency and build strategy now matter as much as sheer damage output.

We understand this may be uncomfortable for the players who were used to their ship builds. But we hope that new opportunities and challenges will introduce you to different weapon setups while we continue keeping an eye out on the weapon balance.

notes.title: Q: How has the maximum speed of ships changed after the rebalance?

items.text: A: Gone are the days of 200-knot flying boats (with rare exceptions). With a well-planned build—say, ten Level 6 cannons—you can still reach a comfortable 80–130 knots, depending on your hull choice.

notes.title: Q: Why disable multiple respawn points and limit respawning to the Three Whales?

items.text: A: By leaving only one respawn point at the Three Whales, we’ve raised the stakes for each life. Returning to your death spot now requires using a translocator—and possibly a powerbank to recharge it. We also disabled forced cargo drops on death so you can decide whether to return to the place of your demise or move on.

notes.title: Q: What do you hope to achieve with these changes?

items.text: A: We aim for a balance in which every player can build a ship tailored to their play style or a specific activity, weighing survivability, firepower, and speed. We also updated repair costs—previous resource requirements didn’t match gameplay realities, so most players repaired only hulls. Now that ship preservation is vital, lower repair costs will help.

notes.title: Q: What data will you focus on after the update? Which feedback is most important?

items.text: A: We’re closely monitoring event statistics, ship and weapon selections, and player feedback on energy and weapon balance. We want to know what challenges you face when rebuilding your ship, whether your generators are sufficient, and your thoughts on the new meta and weapon balance. Your insights will guide our future balance decisions.

notes.title: Q: Will you continue to make balance tweaks going forward?

items.text: A: We’ve already released one balance patch and will continue to track the situation and apply further adjustments as needed.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44795011/68174a4ac4699e6ef0279d7c009eec79959189c1.jpg"]

• Re-balanced energy consumption

Electricity can no longer power everything at once; you must now allocate it wisely between firepower, speed, and survivability. All weapons and equipment draw significantly more energy. The longer a weapon’s range, the higher its energy cost.

As before, longer-range weapons consume more energy and now also aim more slowly. Grenade launcher projectiles detonate on contact with water.

releases.displayName: Meet the Beyond the Waves update!

items.text: We’re proud to present the Beyond the Waves update featuring captivating storylines, powerful weapons and new challenges that are sure to please even the most seasoned captains.

The update introduces an entirely new team-based PvP mode, Control Points, where players must work together to capture and defend strategically important locations scattered across the waters. For those seeking even greater challenges, the game now features five dangerous zones, each guarded by formidable bosses of varying difficulty levels. Additionally, exciting stories await you in a new quest line. Your team will also gain a new crew member.

In this episode, we invite you to face off against a world boss lurking beyond the sector's edge. This unique new enemy will test your combat skills and strategies, delivering an epic battle unlike anything you've seen before in Age of Water.
To help you deal with the enemies more effectively, you can unlock a sixth tier of weapons with devastating firepower, including rocket launchers!

The world of Age of Water has become even more diverse with the addition of ten new land-based combat areas. Your crew will engage in intense close-quarters combat, while you'll need to adapt to new conditions and employ previously unseen tactics.

Fixed bugs in displaying some character names in dialogues.
Corrected mixed-up names for metal and wooden signboards.
Fixed the ship window at a resolution of 5760x1080.
Multiple technical fixes and optimizations.
Corrections to bugs in dialogues and texts.
Soon after the Beyond the Waves launches, we will conclude the Early Access phase and officially release the final version of Age of Water.

releases.displayName: An update that is bigger than usual

notes.title: We have prepared big update 1.0.33.3408 for you

items.text: Improved stability of all ranks 3-5 hulls.
Increased engine power for some of the high-ranked hulls.
Player boats' behavior upon collision now appears smoother.
The balance of all funnels and air intakes has been changed starting from rank 2. Funnels are now a comparably effective alternative.
Fixed a bug that caused the boat to disappear when assembling from a blueprint during a poor connection.
It is no longer necessary to hold the "E" key to pick up pontoons and stunned sharks.
Added a re-connection algorithm for text and voice chats.
Fixed a bug in the durability parameter of the "Iron Warrior's Funnel."
Corrected the display of hull speed when comparing hull characteristics in the boarding window.
Improved ship behavior when docking; ships now get stuck in objects less often.
The ship window now indicates low energy output values.
Fixed issues when continuing crafting after re-entering the game.
To enhance understanding of progress in the game, more quests are now marked as main and storyline quests.
The "Lost Cargo Delivery" quest is no longer given if the chest with lost cargo has not dropped.
Fixed logical errors in the "Sharkees' adolescence" quest.
Added a missing marker in the "A Shipwright for the Base" quest.
Added hints in the "The turning point" quest.
Giant whirlpools now do not appear too close to each other.
The skill crafting window now displays correctly when too many skills have been learned.
Fixed a bug where the allied ship marker would not show after re-entering the game.
Fixed a bug that prevented group entry into an instance from working properly.
Fixed a bug that prevented talking to the character Shaya at the base.
Improved smoke effect from falling hang gliders.
Changed the healing effect of the enemy’s repair module.
Fixed low-quality texture for treasure icons on the sonar.
Minor improvements to AI behavior.
In the change log at game startup, major updates will now be displayed separately.
Text corrections in various localizations.
Improved navigation in the technology menu at the base.
Adapted hints for slots in item previews.
In the base shop, "+" and "-" for the quantity of purchased items are now correctly highlighted.

The major update will bring numerous improvements, including: a new quest line and ships, instant building construction, enhanced weapons, a drone for automatic loot collection, improved speed balance, and much more.
Continuation of the Silver Fleet questline, concluding the main story of the current game season.
Antagonist questline featuring battles against four new bosses.
Quests to recruit two new crew members.
The shipwright now has three new unique ships. They can be obtained by completing his quests.
Crafting items and building structures no longer require time. Ship module and weapon repair time has been significantly reduced. Dismantling buildings at the base returns 90% of the resources.

New enhanced weapons: "reinforced" for ranks 2 and 3 and "shark" for ranks 4 and 5. Enhanced weapons require fragments, which are obtained through fishing, treasure hunting, shark hunting, among shipwrecks of Armadas and some other ships. Crafted at the base.
New Armadas for playing at maximum difficulty. Lots of experience, medallions, and resources for crafting enhanced weapons. Also, new ships of ranks 3, 4, and 5 for boarding.
Increased experience gained when sinking large ships. Added cork drops.
Repeatable PVP/PVE quests for late game stages.
Drone for automatic loot collection. Built at the base.
New modules, including rare and themed ones. Obtained from enemies.
New paints available in the base store.
Improved balance of the power supply system. Changed parameters of batteries, generators, boost, and some skills.
Improved speed balance. Changed parameters of some engines and hulls. Returned capacities, energy consumption during boost, etc. Improved stability during turns.
Increased efficiency of high-rank pumps.
Many deck superstructures now have modifiers for the equipment installed onto them.
The Armada spawn points and fishing locations are now shown on the map.
Now when crafting items and resources at your base, you can choose the quantity beforehand.
Armor modules now cover the hull better.
Sailor Lin will be able to wear a wig.
Fishing rods now have different ranks and are available for crafting at the base.
The ship’s rank is now visible in the Ship Menu.
Fixed various map, inventory and item display bugs.
Improved stability of engine sounds.
Fixed problems with calculating some achievements.
Fixed the battering ram damage.
Fixed problems with the battle at Camel Rock.
Time for changing the flag for PvP has been reduced to 15 minutes.
Time for boarding a defeated ship has been increased to 20 minutes. The hold of your previous ship now becomes a player’s "Lost Cargo" chest and won’t be lost.
Minefields with a lot of explosives now appear more frequently. Increased the number of resources acquired from broken and deactivated mines.
Improved anchored ship stability.
Added an arrow showing the exact direction of the whirlpool teleport.
Many corrections in the models of characters, interiors, islands, etc.
Fixed bugs in various quests.
Fixed the "shaking" of NPC in dialogues.
Added voicelines for some dialogues.
Refined some texts and descriptions.
Some UI improvements for game controllers.
The episode "Against the Tide" concludes the storyline that began with the release of the base game in the spring of this year.

We are preparing a small update to stabilize the ship physics. We will improve the stability of the ships during turns, especially at high speeds, and slightly reduce the impact of the Fan Motors on acceleration.
Shot splash effect from friendly and neutral boats has been disabled to counteract intentional capsizing.
Explosives yield has been increased.
The positions of resource extraction points have been revised so that the streams do not pass through them.
A bug that could cause a player's lost cargo chest to go missing has been fixed.
In the quest log, new quests are now always displayed at the top of the list, so you don't miss anything important.
Sudden bouncing of the ship at high speed has been fixed.
Occasions where the crew refused to pump out water should not happen anymore.
Changed the cost of repairing pumps.
You can now skip the repair and resource exchange offer when entering the base (in the game settings).
Improved the display of quest markers for the Hakke's Caches quest
Map settings are now saved between game sessions.
Added missing tooltip for the icon displaying the color differentiation of the danger level in the map window.
Added selection of zoom options to settings.
Added additional lines in localizations.

Fixed the behavior of hulls during explosions: cannons no longer overturn ships that weigh several tons. Explosions from cannon hits have been reduced in power. Repelling force of grenade explosions has been rebalanced.
An error that caused the player to lose crafting materials has been fixed.
Support for partial items acquiring has been added for controllers on all platforms.
Hints with item stats have been added to the base inventory, in the exchange and boarding menus, and in the tech, crafting, and research menus.
Previous settings are now saved when opening a map.
Now it is possible to disassemble a wooden steering wheel.
Map navigation with a controller has been improved.
Several missing icons have been added to the mini map.
A quest marker for one of the Ambassador’s quests (Anything for me?) has been added.
Random dredge points have been added to the sea.
Cruise control now has only one setting and isn’t canceled after small collisions.
Small improvements to the UI and texts.
Added function to allow mass-disassembly of items in the inventory.
A new item has been introduced that allows a player to reset the skills of a selected crew member. This item can be found in the store at the base.
Fixed “Best of the Best” achievement. All players who fulfilled the requirements for it will get it automatically after logging into the game.
Improved gamepad map navigation. It is possible to put a mark in the map corner.
Fixed medallion reward display in the Convoy mission.
Fixed some unexpected death cases for enemies.
Post offices now treated as respawn points when sunk.
Excessive force can now break the drag rope.
Fixed jumping crew icons while in emergency mode.
Some localization fixes.
At the request of players, emojis were replaced with more useful ones.
Fixed a bug due to which the “Brynhild Motorsailer Mast” could not be installed on the deck.
Crew skills have been rebalanced. Progression now accelerates towards level 20.
Delays in combat scenarios on the map have been adjusted.
Reduced the excessive drop of wheels in loot.
Item crafting at the base now continues correctly, even if the player offline.
Spawn delays have been introduced for some enemies.
A bug has been fixed due to which the echo sounder could not be activated after boarding.
The amount of loot has been increased further to make progress more comfortable. Also, you will now harvest more loot from bigger ships.
Seaweed fields have been added to the map.
Stones are now grouped in 10 item stacks.
Support for custom map markers has been added for gamepads.
Now after a boarded ship disappears, your items are put into a chest and do not disappear. It makes life easier and you will not lose your precious loot!
In order to ease your progress in the game, we have increased the amount of resources you get when destroying enemies or farming the seabed.
Increased number of mining points in locations where you can farm resources.
We have switched off music at the base since many of you noted that it can get really annoying.
Activating the anchor in a flow stream now stops your boat.
Balanced experience gains in the repeating Shark City quest. The boss now yields 400 Exp.
Fixed a bug when a player’s boat could be seen in the open sea while they are at the base.
Added missing map icons.
Added quest marker for the “engineer for the Base”
Changed cost of the artisan workshop at the base.
Fishing rods now have the ‘equipment’ category.
Changed visual highlighting of the boarding window.
Fixed a bug with cloth given in the Halibut wheelhouse dismantle menu.
Fixed some localization bugs and typos.
Improved game stability.
Players who damaged an enemy may now receive a portion of experience, medallions, and loot when that enemy is sunk.
A "My lost cargo" chest can now be retrieved for corks from one of the traders at the Three Whales or at the Tirpitz.
An error that caused the "base on wheels" model to rotate when the camera drew away from it has been fixed.
Stability of the game client and servers has been improved.
You can now meet unexpected enemies in the southern part of the sector.
Fixed a bug where the enemy in the quest “Big Snatch” was invisible to players.
Fixed a bug where crafting progress at a player's base continued, but appeared as cancelled in the interface.
An error that caused the fog of war to re-appear across the map has been fixed.
A bug that made the player unable to progress in the "With Fire and Sword" mission and also locking the dialogues in the Tirpitz has been fixed.
The number of medallions that can be obtained for participating in the mission “Mangrove Pearl Mining” has been increased by 50%.
Fixed a bug when some technologies at the base did not complete and continued to research. Just click on the research icon again if you have this issue from before the update.
Changed the required number of items to craft some pumps, motors, generators, exhaust pipes and air ducts.
Wooden Box and a Box with Instruments can now be disassembled to get resources
Now you can find “Rags” in loot more often.
Locations “Big snake” and some quest markers are added to both map and mini-map.
Removed annoying message about craft completion at the base.
Fixed some animations and character models.
Fixed bug allowing technical work message to double.
Fixed bug making some quest boats to not appear at designed spawn point.
Fixed bug causing manual pump to operate without crew member appointed.
Fixed an issue where players could receive extra items after boarding ships.
Fixed animation of movement aboard “Master Tuck” raft.
Fixed some dialogue text errors.
Fixed bug causing player lost cargo chest to be stuck in a building.
Fixed a bug that caused incorrect quality of items to be obtained after completing crafting.
Fixed an issue that could lead to rare cases of player progress rollback.
Fixed research time for some base technologies at Level 5.
Fixed incorrect rolling of starter mast with camera movement.
Improved server performance!
Improved server performance (some fixes still underway).
Fixed display of the Steam player name.
· Rebalanced progression of the crew members from default edition of the game - now they reach the same stats as in Gold Edition faster.
Fishing pole recipe is now back in the game to craft a pole.
Removed Shark City unconditional buildings.
